title: Analyzing the Endeavours of the Supreme Court of India to Transcribe and Translate Court Arguments in Light of the Proposed EU AI Act

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of the risk of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems exhibiting bias against non-native English speakers and diverse regional Indian accents, based on literature review and policy analysis of the Supreme Court's operational context.

Evaluation of linguistic disparity by categorizing Indian languages into resource classes (based on prior literature) to assess the risks and feasibility of translating legal texts from English into under-resourced Indian languages.
